newsitem.title: ITALY: Attempted break-in at Versace's Italian tomb.
newsitem.headline: Attempted break-in at Versace's Italian tomb.

text.p: The vault housing the ashes of murdered fashion guru Gianni Versace has been broken into, Italian state television reported on Wednesday.

The report said one or more intruders tried to prise open the family tomb in the northern Italian village of Moltrasio, breaking a lock on the vault door but apparently fleeing after triggering a security alarm.
The urn containing Versace's ashes was untouched.
Police were not immediately available to confirm the report.
Versace was laid to rest in Moltrasio on the banks of Lake Como, where he owned a villa, following his murder at his Miami beach mansion last month.
His alleged killer, Andrew Cunanan, who was wanted for a string of murders, later shot himself and the motive for the designer's slaying remained unclear.
